summary: Leonardo notebook volume in the Victoria and Albert Museum, London, MSL/1876/Forster/141/I. Two notebooks bound together: I1 (ff. 1 to 40v) begun in Florence in July 1505, I2 (ff. 41r to 55) c.1487 to 1490, Milan.
history: bought in Vienna by Robert Bulwer Lytton (1862 per Scala)
bequeathed by Forster to the South Kensington (now V&A) Museum, 1876
